content.comment_body: Are IDEC smart relay and [company_name] [product_name] essentially the same? I recently examined both smart relays and noticed that the hardware appears similar.

Hello [user_name], A related discussion from another forum covers the development timeline of Smart Relays: [url] The consensus there is that [company_name] introduced the first generation [product_name] as the initial Smart Relay on the market in 1996, with other companies like Moeller and Mitsubishi later developing and re-branding their own models. Details on re-branding and joint ventures in the automation sector aren't always clear, but it's evident that while the hardware might be similar, different brands offer unique communication interfaces: both [product_name] and IDEC have integrated Ethernet ports, Zelio requires an add-on module for Ethernet, and EASY uses RS-485. Additionally, software functionality, memory size, and instruction lists vary across brands. Hope this clarifies things, [user_name]
You may want to refer to the table in the link below before this post is removed: [url]
The EASY E4 features only an RJ45 Ethernet port for communication using Modbus TCP.

[product_name] and IDEC Smart Relay are no longer fully identical. Software Used: - [product_name]Soft Comfort V8.3.0 (2020-09-21) - WindLGC V8.2.0 (2018-11-15) Hardware Models Tested: - [article_no], FW: V1.08.02, FS: 02 - [article_no], FW: V1.82.01, FS: 01 - [article_no], FW: V1.83.02, FS: 04 - FL1F-H12RCE, FW: V1.82.01, FS: 05 Compatibility Observations: - [product_name]Soft Comfort cannot upload/download projects to IDEC Smart Relay FL1F-H12RCE V1.82.01; earlier versions were compatible. - WindLGC V8.2 works with [product_name] base module [article_no] V1.08.02, but not with other listed [product_name] hardware versions. File Interoperability: - .lsc files from WindLGC V8.2.0 can be edited in [product_name]Soft Comfort V8.3.0, and vice versa if previous hardware types (such as [product_name] 8.1 or 8.2) are selected before saving. Files saved under hardware [product_name] 8.3 will not open in WindLGC V8.2 unless re-saved as older types. User Manuals: - [product_name]Soft Comfort Online Help and WindLGC Online Help ([url]) are nearly identical, except for 'What’s new' sections and upgrade schedules. IDEC’s versions may include multiple [product_name] updates in one. Project Interface: - The desktop interfaces differ by brand name and icon, though function blocks may look similar but carry different names. Networking: - [product_name] and IDEC can be networked together with effort. Set up both devices in network mode, import their programs, create network connections, and then download respective programs. The process is similar on both platforms. CIM Module: - The [product_name] CIM only interacts with memory locations, not with the base module directly, so its functionality is unaffected by the brand. CMR Module: - Not tested; [company_name] does not produce a compatible CMR for the region.

analysis.insight_summary: Community members investigated if IDEC smart relay and [company_name] [product_name] are interchangeable in terms of hardware and software. Initial hardware similarities exist, but newer models exhibit differences, especially in communication interfaces, file compatibility, and software support. Compatibility between [product_name]Soft Comfort and IDEC’s WindLGC has become limited with recent versions, leading to challenges in using cross-platform files and software features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect IDEC Smart Relay and [company_name] [product_name] to be both hardware- and software-compatible, enabling seamless uploading/downloading of projects and utilization of files and features across both platforms.
